remarks:
Marrano Homes is excited to introduce the newest phase of Bush Meadows in North Tonawanda! This stunning community combines modern design, thoughtful functionality, and stylish finishes to create a home perfectly suited for today’s lifestyle.

This to be built Dis IX home has a charming full front porch featuring Craftsman-inspired accents. Inside, a welcoming two-story foyer leads into an inviting open-concept living space designed for both everyday living and entertaining. The gourmet kitchen flows seamlessly into the family room and sunroom, creating a bright and airy gathering space. The kitchen is sure to impress with sleek quartz countertops, pantry, and an angled island with convenient seating. Additional highlights include a dedicated home office, a spacious mudroom conveniently located off the two-car garage, and a second-floor laundry. Retreat to the luxurious primary suite, complete with a spacious bath featuring dual sinks and a generous linen closet. With a thoughtful blend of beautiful design and practical features, this home offers the comfort, convenience, and style you've been looking for.

Don't miss your opportunity to make this beautiful Bush Meadows home yours! Photos are of a similar home.  This listing is for a to be built home. In Bush Meadows Phase 2 there are 34 lots.  Ranch and two story homes will be built with square footage ranging from 1,300 sq ft - 2,500 sq ft. The Bush Meadows model at 274 Cardinal Way is open Monday–Wednesday from 1:00–4:00 PM and Saturday & Sunday from 1:00–5:00 PM. Taxes are TBD.
